detail.name: Ye Shunguang's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Ye Shunguang's Mindscape: Swordswoman
detail.desc2:
A namecard bearing the image of Ye Shunguang.
This card never circulates publicly; it's said that only a select few "fated recipients" ever obtain one. Possessing it grants a one-time "Void Hunter assistance."
On the back is a hand-drawn doodle of a face and a line of neat handwriting:
"No matter when... if you ever need me, just come find me. If I can help, I'd be happy to!"
